scope: Local fictional card-policy drafting prototype; classifier scores are not answer accuracy.

classification.selection: Three-fold stratified train-only CV, C in [3,10,30,100], mean macro-F1; thresholds chosen on 8002/2001 train-only split; seed 42.
classification.test_role: Previously inspected official test, a development benchmark rather than a blind final estimate.
limitations: Uncalibrated softmax; the review threshold is not an out-of-domain detector.
Quantized ONNX vectors can depend on batch size. These historical batch-16 scores do not establish the same accuracy for the app single-question path.
Only logistic regression was trained. MPNet and Qwen are pretrained, not fine-tuned here.

current_workflow.selection: Similarity ranks all sections; topic and explicit card-procedure rules select applicable sources. The panel shows the top three plus the selected section if needed.
current_workflow.record_or_unsupported_requests: No generation call; explicit worker guidance.
current_workflow.validation: JSON fields, selected citation IDs, known sensitive-request/cause patterns and known policy omissions. Not semantic truth validation.
current_workflow.failure: An unaccepted draft is not displayed as a model answer. Selected policy text is labeled Policy reference for worker editing.
current_workflow.human_review: Required for every reply before download; nothing is sent automatically.

development_evaluation.method: English questions and material policy expectations were authored before generation. Routing/prompt fixes used these small development sets; follow-up findings also led to bounded guard corrections. Counts below are the rerun of the current version, not an untouched holdout or independent human evaluation.
development_evaluation.conditions: Windows local run; MPNet quantized ONNX CPU, two threads, question batch 1 and policy batch 2; portable Ollama, one resident local Qwen model. Timing is a warm-model observation on one machine.
interpretation: Accepted by bounded checks does not mean complete, factually correct or ready to send.
Developer inspection assisted by AI found omissions, unnecessary repeated questions and invented or conflicting customer context even among accepted drafts.
Phrase matching can also reject a semantically adequate paraphrase. Source-reference fallback and mandatory worker review remain necessary.
Small fictional examples do not measure customer-wide, production or held-out generalization performance.

followup_examples.question: The app shows my virtual card and the physical card that has just arrived. Which card should I select for activation, and what comes after the app confirmation?
I selected the physical card that arrived, updated the app, and tried activation on a stable connection. The error is 'Activation temporarily unavailable'. What should I do if this continues?
Part of my physical card has broken off. I am worried it could get stuck in the shop reader. What is the safe replacement procedure?
I tried to use my card and it did not work. I have not written down any details yet. What should I tell support first?
My new card was ordered on Friday and dispatched on Monday. How is the normal card delivery window counted when a public holiday falls that week?

I opened the card Delivery page in the app but there is no tracking link. My card has not arrived either. Is a link always available, and what timing information should I check before asking for a delivery review?
A website rejected my card payment at checkout, but I closed the page before noting the message. What information should I collect and what app checks can I make?
The payment verification screen says a security code was sent, but it has not arrived while I am paying online. What should I check, and what information should I give support if it stays missing?
My inserted-card payment was declined at a shop. The error says 'PIN error' and I saw it at another terminal too. Should I keep trying the PIN, or are there other checks?
I activated my new card and paid once by inserting it and entering my PIN. Contactless is still failing at different terminals. What is the next step?
Please look up my order and confirm whether my physical card has actually been dispatched. I need the real status rather than the usual delivery estimate.
I did not receive the verification code for logging into my account. How do I get signed in? This is not a payment verification step.

earlier_generation_comparison.role: Historical development comparison with the old prompt, not comparable success rates for the current workflow.
earlier_generation_comparison.review: AI-assisted developer inspection, not independent human validation.
